root_cause: _collect_normal_exit_cleanup scans forward from body_end with only a 'no user code' guard, so it walks past the WITH exit block and absorbs the enclosing if's else block (a bare LOAD_CONST None; RETURN_VALUE) into WithRegion.cleanup_blocks. The else branch then has no block left to own it and the outer if is emitted without its else, which re-lays the two return-None blocks and flips the conditional jump target.
three_elements: P1 anchor: only reachable-after-WITH blocks are candidates for normal-exit cleanup.
P2 identity: the WITH's own exit block (the unique post-WITH jump/fall-through successor found by _find_with_exit_block) is the structural upper bound of that cleanup range.
P3 bound: cleanup scanning terminates at the first block strictly beyond that exit block; the exit block itself keeps the pre-existing Round02-F5 ownership logic untouched.
